items.title: Terms & Conditions

All gold jewellery is BIS hallmarked with a unique HUID; diamonds are certified by independent laboratories.
Please keep this e-bill and your certificates for exchange, buyback and service.
Goods once sold are covered by the ORRA exchange and buyback policy in force at the time of the request.

items.title: Exchange & buyback
items.body:
Exchange or sell back your ORRA jewellery at any ORRA store across India.
Bring the jewellery with this e-bill and its certificates. Value is worked out on the gold rate of the day and the diamond value under the policy in force.

items.title: Caring for your jewellery

Store each piece separately in its ORRA box, away from perfume, lotions and chlorine.
Clean gently with lukewarm water and a soft brush.
Visit any ORRA store for a free clean and check-up of the settings.
